content:
Today, Instapaper launched version 10 of its iPhone and iPad apps, which, in addition to multiple improvements, also brings a major overhaul to its web platform. Details are as follows.

"The biggest iOS app update in over a decade"

Instapaper today (via MacMagazine) announced updates to its iOS app, while adding a brand-new AI voice feature to its Android app and completing a comprehensive revamp of its website.

Instapaper 10 for iOS adds support for the Liquid Glass interface and introduces four reading fonts:

Literata: a serif font designed by Google for Google Play Books. New York: a serif font designed by Apple for iOS. Open Sans: a sans-serif font commissioned by Google. Atkinson Hyperlegible: a sans-serif font developed by the Braille Institute.

This update also adds Home Screen widgets, which Instapaper says can display the article you're currently reading and recently saved items, while also serving as a one-tap shortcut to start reading.

Instapaper says that for iPad users, this update improves multitasking performance; while iPhone and iPad users alike will notice more reliable background syncing, faster article download speeds, and a redesigned onboarding tour.

Instapaper says this is the biggest update in over a decade, which also includes:

Folder count display: All folders will now show how many articles or notes they contain. If you find that folder counts only make you more anxious, you can turn them off under Settings > Behavior > Folder Count. Folder sorting: To sort folders or tags, tap the "…" menu next to the folder title, then choose your preferred sort order. Article list appearance: We've added a compact mode, new fonts and styles, and a simple way to customise the look of the article list. In the article list, tap "…" and then tap "Appearance" to adjust the style, fonts, and image thumbnails.

Finally, Instapaper has given its web platform a complete overhaul, adding features such as a three-column reading mode and keyboard shortcuts; the Android app has also gained a new AI voice feature.
